Applies the app, video, browser, and YouTube study rules you choose. Screen content stays on your device.

StudyOrbit uses Android Accessibility to identify apps, detect short-video viewers, and check the visible website address or YouTube channel against your rules. It can go back or cover a blocked screen. The screen content it inspects is never saved or shared.
